perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Primary evidence shows a $9.6 billion Q2 backlog dominated by natural-gas projects, with more than 60% tied to power-generation/local-distribution demand and a fully subscribed Amarillo Expansion linked to Texas Panhandle data-center demand.
The prior bounded fresh check found no materially newer primary disclosure, so the backlog-and-load-growth signal remains the defensible frontier without repeated browsing.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: About $660 million of expansion projects entering service in Q2 plus $2.0 billion operating cash flow and $1.0 billion free cash flow after capex are concrete execution and funding evidence.
The next useful evidence is project-level in-service conversion and realized returns rather than another restatement of backlog.

unknowns: durability of incremental data-center gas demand
